patch_description: Duplicate the entire RY→CNOT→RZ→ZZ(ring+cross)→CNOT→RZ sequence as a second block appended after the first, reusing all four existing parameter names (ry_a, ry_b, rz_p, zz_ring) so n_distinct_params stays at 4. In the second block, replace the long-range cross-coupling pattern ([0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7]) with the complementary diagonal set ([0,5],[1,6],[2,7],[3,4]), giving the circuit richer non-local entanglement coverage across both diagonal directions of the qubit register. This increases expressive power and connectivity (helping separate the worst-margin group) while keeping the parameter count fixed, following the proven "sandwich" motif that previously improved margins without harming convergence speed.
